name: security_cve_triage
instructions: Extract vulnerability facts from the supplied advisory spans.

attack_vector.description: How the vulnerability is exploited, as stated in the source; choose exactly one listed value.

severity.description: Severity grounded in the source impact statement: critical only for explicit remote code execution or active exploitation without mitigations.

has_patch.description: True only when the source names an available patch, fix version, or mitigation with cited evidence.

summary.description: One or two sentences supported only by the cited source quotes, no outside knowledge.
